name: io.github.rubatoyd/law-openapi-mcp
description: Korean national law information search (statutes, decrees, case law, treaties)

environmentVariables.name: LAW_OC
environmentVariables.description: User identifier for the Korean Ministry of Government Legislation OPEN API (open.law.go.kr). This is the local part of the e-mail address used at sign-up, chosen by the user. Not a secret. Required.

environmentVariables.name: LAW_OS_TRUST
environmentVariables.description: Use the OS trust store for TLS (1=on, default). Set 0 to disable. Needed on school/corporate networks that intercept SSL.
